answer: The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in willow, expire in relic, and ocean lists each expiry. Someone running 92 aliases hence needs 134 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 978 identities would post 3777 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
